models_evaluated: dual machine learning models for infection and sepsis prediction

links.outcome: Model discrimination (AUROC) across internal, reduced-feature and external MIMIC-IV validation cohorts
links.effect: AUROC ranged from 0.75 to 0.85 across internal, reduced-feature and external validation cohorts, described as consistent discrimination.
links.quote: The dual-model system demonstrated consistent discrimination across internal, reduced-feature and external validation cohorts, with area under the receiver operating characteristic curves ranging from 0.75 to 0.85.

screen.reason: The study prospective deployed a real-time dual-model clinical decision support system for sepsis and infection risk in an ICU, evaluating bedside implementation and pre-post clinical outcomes without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
